classification.difficultyReason: Four supplementary-angle calculations. The student must read which marked angles are interior and which are exterior at each vertex, and convert in both directions. Slightly more interpretation than the reference, and no sum rule is needed.

content.prompt: Work out the sizes of the exterior angles at A and C and the interior angles at B and D.

answer.short: Exterior at $A=80^{\circ}$, interior at $B=76^{\circ}$, exterior at $C=68^{\circ}$, interior at $D=72^{\circ}$.
answer.worked:
Each interior angle and its exterior angle sum to $180^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Exterior at }A&=180^{\circ}-100^{\circ}=80^{\circ}\\\text{Interior at }B&=180^{\circ}-104^{\circ}=76^{\circ}\\\text{Exterior at }C&=180^{\circ}-112^{\circ}=68^{\circ}\\\text{Interior at }D&=180^{\circ}-108^{\circ}=72^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
